overview: The committee discussed a revised timeline from the MSBA requiring a reduction from 29 to 3-5 building options by April, reviewed updated evaluation criteria, and approved an amended scoring matrix for preliminary design options.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee tabled the approval of the March 17 minutes because they had not been distributed to all members.

items.title: MSBA Schedule and Timeline Update
items.summary: The project team explained that the MSBA requested the committee narrow its 29 preliminary options down to 3-5 by April 2nd to expedite the review process.

items.title: Review of Revised Evaluation Criteria
items.summary: The committee reviewed additions to the evaluation matrix regarding site stewardship, maintenance, and community access for CTE and athletic facilities.

items.title: Motion to Apply Cost Weighting Multiplier
items.summary: A motion to apply a multiplier of 10 to cost criteria for concepts within the original RFP cost range failed to receive a second.

items.title: Review of Building Alternatives (B and C Options)
items.summary: The committee walked through addition, renovation, and gymnasium-salvage options, focusing on educational flexibility, building height, and the impact of windowless classrooms.

items.title: Motion to Amend Ease of Maintenance Scores
items.summary: Approved a motion to change the 'Ease of Maintenance' scores from 0 to 2 for several tall building options (C3.1, C3.2, D1.1, and D2.1).

items.title: Review of D Options and Pool Considerations
items.summary: Discussion centered on the feasibility of a standalone pool, MSBA reimbursement restrictions, and the potential for a separate debt exclusion vote for aquatic facilities.

items.title: Motion to Amend Passing Time Scores
items.summary: Approved a motion to change scores for 'navigating time between classes' to 2 for any building option exceeding four floors.

items.title: Approval of Evaluation Matrix
items.summary: Approved the evaluation matrix as amended for public posting and use in the upcoming option-narrowing process.

items.title: Straw Poll for Narrowing Options
items.summary: Approved a motion to conduct a non-binding straw poll of both voting and non-voting members to focus the discussion at the next meeting on the top 3-5 preferred options.

subject: High School Building Design Option Narrowing
